title: Work Order, version 1
description: One Work Order per file under content/work_orders/ (work order 022, part 1; GDD section 6, Guilds, Work Orders, and Favour). 'id' is wo.<zone>.<faction>.<name>: zone one of rustmoor, cinderworks, thunderhead, global (the same list as item ids); faction is the seal's registry id without its 'favour.' prefix (the work_orders check's id-form rule). 'act' is the act the order belongs to, 1 to 3; the work_orders check holds 'seal' to the seals a player has met by that act, and the reveal check holds 'request' to that act's reveal words. 'seal' is the faction's Favour quality id in docs/canon/qualities.json, e.g. favour.board. 'band' is the player level band the order is offered in, {min, max}, whole levels 1 to 100; min <= max and the band lying inside its zone's band are checked in code. 'asks' is the items handed in, a non-empty list of {item, qty}, each item at most once (checked in code). 'reward' is {favour, crowns}: the faction Favour paid (the work_orders check holds it to the settled amount) and a Crown reward of at least 1 (work order 022: 'its faction's Favour, plus a modest Crown reward'; the ceiling is read from tuning.work_orders/* and checked in code). An order pays nothing else: no gear and no bound items, so the reward object takes no other field. 'request' is the one-line request in the faction's voice; its word limit and banned words are the style check's. Whether each asked item exists is the references check's job; unbound, and made or dropped in the order's zone at or below its band, are the work_orders check's. 'revision' is optional and exists only so a register row's revision can match the file.
